value.name: Reconstruction from active monodromy data

research.author: packet 2026-09-14: LLM-derived, no claim-specific human check, no Lean kernel build
research.reason: mirror of K12-01 in keller-groupoids; its status there is llm proved

value.statement: Étale-maximal Keller maps correspond to active monodromy data whose canonical étale filling is affine space; the Jacobian-conjecture counterexample condition is equivalent to existence of a nontrivial active datum whose étale filling contains a dense open A^n.

research.reason: mirror of KG-03 in keller-groupoids; its status there is llm proved

value.statement: For every r, K_r(f) is the disjoint union over set partitions π of [r] of C_|π|(f); equivalently K_r≅⊔_k S(r,k) \operatorname{Conf}_k.

value.name: Top configuration open immersion

research.author: packet 2026-09-14: LLM-derived, no claim-specific human check, no Lean kernel build
research.reason: mirror of KG-07 in keller-groupoids; its status there is llm proved

value.statement: The forgetful map \operatorname{Conf}_d→\operatorname{Conf}_{d-1} is an open immersion, and it is an isomorphism iff f has no fiber with exactly d−1 points.

value.name: Top configuration realizes Galois closure

research.author: packet 2026-09-14: LLM-derived, no claim-specific human check, no Lean kernel build
research.reason: mirror of KG-09 in keller-groupoids; its status there is llm proved

value.statement: Over the proper locus, \operatorname{Conf}_d has d!/|G| connected components, each a Galois cover with group G realizing the Galois closure.

value.name: Normal extensions are forbidden for counterexamples

research.author: packet 2026-09-14: LLM-derived, no claim-specific human check, no Lean kernel build
research.reason: mirror of KG-17 in keller-groupoids; its status there is llm proved

value.statement: If the function-field extension of f is Galois the monodromy action is regular and |G| = d, and by Campbell's criterion f is then invertible; so a nontrivial Keller groupoid has |G| > d. There is no degree-two complex Keller counterexample, and S_3 in degree three is the first non-Galois possibility.
